    Long morphisms of a minimal crown (BO13a Lemma 5 b), c)) #

    • ZChain.not_le_both_σ, ZChain.not_le_both_ρ: Lemma 5 b) for chains.
    • MulBasis.long_entry: every long morphism is an entry of every crown.
    • MulBasis.σ_nbr_red, MulBasis.ρ_nbr_red: the neighbours of a long entry are reducible (Lemma 5 a)).
    • MulBasis.lemma5c: a crown with a long entry has a second, different long entry.

    theorem LargeIndecomposable.RayCat.ZChain.not_le_both_σ {Q : Type} [CategoryTheory.Category.{0, 0} Q] [CategoryTheory.Limits.HasZeroMorphisms Q] (Z : ZChain Q) (hQ : OneSidedCyclic Q) (s : ℕ) :
    ¬(FactorsThroughMorphism (Z.ρ s) (Z.σ s) ∧ FactorsThroughMorphism (Z.ρ (s + 1)) (Z.σ s))

    BO13a Lemma 5 b): the neighbours ρ s, ρ (s+1) of σ s are not both below σ s.

    source
    theorem LargeIndecomposable.RayCat.ZChain.not_le_both_ρ {Q : Type} [CategoryTheory.Category.{0, 0} Q] [CategoryTheory.Limits.HasZeroMorphisms Q] (Z : ZChain Q) (hQ : OneSidedCyclic Q) (t : ℕ) :
    ¬(FactorsThroughMorphism (Z.σ t) (Z.ρ (t + 1)) ∧ FactorsThroughMorphism (Z.σ (t + 1)) (Z.ρ (t + 1)))

    BO13a Lemma 5 b), dual form: the neighbours σ t, σ (t+1) of ρ (t+1) are not both below ρ (t+1).
